outcome: In-hospital mortality or maternal end-organ injury
cohort: A cohort of adult patients undergoing inpatient delivery hospitalizations in Florida, Kentucky, Maryland, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, and Washington between 2007 and 2020.
finding: Black and Hispanic patients had higher adjusted odds of in-hospital mortality and maternal end-organ injury after birth compared to White patients, with Black patients also having higher odds of in-hospital mortality.
